contract: The first actual attempt crosses its four-second start-to-close boundary, then the same execution retries after its original one-second backoff. While its second attempt still has start-to-close time and a third attempt remains allowed, the original eight-second schedule-to-close bound expires. Exactly one schedule_to_close ActivityTimedOut must be recorded. Late completion, failure and heartbeat cannot publish an outcome or progress; no third activity delivery may appear. Retain the original parent timeout delivery without fabricating a workflow result. Preserve original run bounds, whole retry policy, task/attempt relationships, typed values and precise immutable history. Use real wall time with no database backdating or deadline extension.
